eval: (()=>{const keep=new Set();document.querySelectorAll('canvas,iframe').forEach(c=>{let e=c;while(e){keep.add(e);e=e.parentElement}});const walk=el=>{for(const ch of el.children){if(keep.has(ch)){walk(ch)}else if(ch.tagName!=='SCRIPT'&&ch.tagName!=='STYLE'){ch.style.visibility='hidden'}}};walk(document.body);document.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(f=>{try{const d=f.contentDocument;const k=new Set();d.querySelectorAll('canvas').forEach(c=>{let e=c;while(e){k.add(e);e=e.parentElement}});const w=el=>{for(const ch of el.children){if(k.has(ch))w(ch);else if(ch.tagName!=='SCRIPT'&&ch.tagName!=='STYLE')ch.style.visibility='hidden'}};w(d.body)}catch(e){}});return 'ok'})()
